label: Tower defence
description: Cooperative tower defence on a map with td_* markers: 15 waves of entity creeps, turrets on pads for team money, 20 base lives. Other maps are untouched. The instance needs g_teamSizeMin 0, g_teamForceBalance 0, g_friendlyFire 0, g_infiniteAmmo 1, and a map pool with only this map.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Builds a turret on the pad you stand on, for team money.

commands.name: upgrade
commands.description: Upgrades the turret on the pad you stand on.

commands.name: sell
commands.description: Sells the turret on the pad you stand on for 70% of what it cost.

commands.name: tdwave
commands.description: Jumps to a wave, for tests.
